statement: The control plane checks a candidate's conditions against the external attributes the platform declares and, after them, those the host's attribute providers declare, as an instance compiles it: a condition on a provider's attribute is checked clean, one on an attribute neither declares does not compile. cosec-migrate publish compiles what it writes the same way: an app or tenant document against the published platform document's condition limits and declared attributes.
guards: control:ProviderAttributesTest#a candidate compiles against the platform's and the providers' attributes
migrate:PublishFileTest#a tenant document compiles against the published platform, as every instance compiles it
